error_variant.description: Name of the polymorphic-variant constructor for the error, without associated data. "Ok" for successful runs. Special values: "Aborted" for `Aborted, "Exn:<exn_name>" for uncaught exceptions.

group_id.description: Group ID read from the stategraph.json in the current working directory.

return_code.description: Process exit code that sgc returned to the shell.

sgc_version.description: Version of the sgc binary that produced the event.

subcommand.description: Subcommand path that failed, in argv order

tenant_id.description: UUID of the tenant the subcommand targeted. Absent for subcommands that take no tenant id, or when parsing it from argv failed.

user_email.description: Email of the user identified by STATEGRAPH_API_KEY, as returned by /api/v1/whoami. Absent when no API key is set, the API base is unknown, the call fails, or the user has no email on file.

user_id.description: UUID of the user identified by STATEGRAPH_API_KEY, as returned by /api/v1/whoami. Absent when no API key is set, the API base is unknown, or the call fails.
